title: Keep Canvas acceptance build caches outside synchronized package source
body:
Current source refresh on actual integration `6181b044`: `519a0beb7451cb6e4410f0bee18c826fc493086e`, tree `2bd99392d53f3df8be0569368450df1c933d3a3a`, ordered parents `6390270c` / `6181b044`. All 1,420 typed entries and executable bits were verified before/after the single full source run: **1,266 passed, 12 skipped**. The original three Canvas fixtures remain exact; all39 retained references passed measured verification. The initial inspector's wrong28-reference guess and early construction commit remain separately retained and are not source admission.

Owner receipt SHA256 `406c50a1360b107fab2a8dbe50a4bfb5ccc1651a45da6189558820f3b0906944`; independent source-push GO `91118b6f1c952b7ee0df2cd6b8b8b174261ee373106ca08ecd130acfe06617c4`. Root normally pushed this accepted source onto the existing branch. Toolkit96, Canvas47, RCC112, configured static/type348, generated8/GitHub30 and owned prepared-input checks passed. Fresh complete CI on actual `6181b044` is required; previous776 CI remains historical.

Current producer274 has261 historical matches/seven changes/six additions; five selected test inputs remain separate and native92498 is UNQUALIFIED for this union. Original browser/V5 measurements retain their old source/native/platform identities. Full #99, actual ChatGPT/current native/private #134 and Runtime publication remain HOLD. Both-parent canonical lessons are retained with no cosmetic child.

<details>
<summary>Retained previous Canvas and acceptance checkpoints</summary>

Current source checkpoint: `6390270cd07851448b7b325c81c98dc11a1d3a17`, tree `6ab0a1c559b583eb7bfd442fa4260aa75af91fdf`, ordinary merge of accepted Canvas source `723397b748b48282e13480b0ab7e4cb4c7e10c8c` with actual integration `77647484b3cdd8e18aabf344a4018ea8ed8e3ea0`.

All 1,410 tracked leaves are accounted for. The three original Canvas test modules and their modes are unchanged; the nine RCC sample members match the accepted #302 source. One complete local suite passed: **1,216 passed, 12 skipped**. Toolkit 96, scoped Canvas and RCC controls, lint, type338, generated workflow round-trip, and all 30 YAML files passed. Independent source review accepted receipt `8385812a…` at this exact head.

The original V1–V4 failures and V5 actual evidence remain intact. V5 belongs to its original source/native tuple; this refresh does not qualify the current whole native wheel, a cold registry, universal process reaping, private acceptance, or the full #99 contract. The current producer map has the accepted RCC adapter delta relative to the old native source. Fresh complete hosted CI, policy checks, and actual integration remain HOLD. This PR stays draft.

<details>
<summary>Preserved prior source and acceptance context</summary>

Current actual774 refresh is independently reviewed and normally pushed at `723397b748b48282e13480b0ab7e4cb4c7e10c8c`, tree `a58412bc551d5927580d9d9d6f5fb8989c67ffc2`, ordered1e9/774. Independent source review `c8a7ce67`. Full source1,200 PASS/12 SKIP; scoped46 PASS/2 actual integration deselections, Toolkit69, configured lint/format/type338 and8 generator roundtrips/all30 YAML passed. Original three fixture/authoring modules and all assertions/deadlines remain exact1e9.

The273 combined bindings are268 production inputs plus five selected tests. All remain exact against1e9/3ec/native92498, with85 named frontend/wrapper inputs preserved. The1192-entry original native manifest, original assetsZIP, external PR282-owned edc7 helper and frozen snapshots, browser, corrected V5 checkpoint and independent1848613d review remain verified before/after source gates. They preserve the original V5 actual ONLY3ec/92498; this changed source head has no new actual qualification. Old1e9 CI is retained separately; fresh exact-head/current774 full hosted and retained forced-hang/private/full99/ChatGPT/coldregistry/wholewheel/release gates remain required. No manual actual retry or integration occurred.

Historical checkpoints follow.

Current source is `1e9c462fc16534f1a6153ef666ae60a9ac9560d6`, tree `4d72bd113397900be41b720282736f6ab4999fb2`, normally pushed on the existing PR branch after independent source review `1fc31354ae289b0c00e851048c772854c21ef8444b24eef319f46226af7da419`. The successor changes two test fixtures and canonical guidance. Synthetic public-wheel samples now use the accepted Git member bytes, preserving strict raw installed-worker hashes and all member/version/ownership/prefix checks. The browser fixture publishes complete Node PID JSON by exclusive temporary write and atomic rename; its bounded reader waits for valid contents. Node identity remains separate from Chromium identity. The original 15/10/25/30/3-second budgets, live-child and cleanup assertions remain unchanged.

Validation: 15 CRLF setup RED failures became three valid baselines and twelve rejecting poison controls; three PID publication RED failures became passing boundary controls. Focused tests 46 pass/2 integration deselections, external controls 18 pass, Toolkit 69 and full source 1,197 pass/12 skip. Configured lint/typecheck 338 files and all eight generated workflows pass unchanged. All production/probe/constants, native producer 268+5 inputs, original native1192 manifest, helpers and browser remain exact. Earlier ENOSPC/formatter/RED failures are preserved. Fresh exact-head Windows/macOS and complete CI, including the actual forced-hang gate, remain required before merge.

The independently accepted V5 execution remains bound to original source3ec/native92498 and corrected scoped receipt28b/independent184. This fixture successor does not inherit a new actual execution. Earlier V2/V3/V4 failures remain failed; full Canvas/ChatGPT/private/whole-wheel/cold-registry/release gates remain open.

Historical source and actual evidence follow with their original identities and limits.

Current source `3ec9d0acbe30ad94d02e4c24fef2587127964495`, tree `8ed17c0c2ed48a3ad4fe89994bab572d028e59ca`, normally merges selector checkpoint066 with actual target1c7585fe on this existing branch. Independent source review `d29a5c618c8ff32effee017bbceed355eda911791dcef8c97260db636bab8615` verifies the exact clean union, all268 producer/five selected-test inputs equal retained92498, full configured Runtime1170 passes/12existing skips, Toolkit69/scoped20 plus full lint/type338 and eight canonical workflow roundtrips. The authoring AST changes only the public Playwright grep literal; product assertions and all ownership/browser/Core/cleanup/deadline gates remain unchanged.

The locked real Playwright --list command demonstrates old14c selector0cases, corrected full-title selector exactly1existing realcase, broadselector2cases and wrongselector a distinct fixture case. Current source is pushed; complete new hosted CI and a separately qualified current-source immutable actual runner are still required. No current native/browser consumer acceptance is claimed.

Original14c qualified V2 actual failed before Runtime startup at pytest collected-module binding. Qualified V3 reached Runtime readiness, three Python MCP tool calls and three public Core member/ownership checks, then Playwright found zero tests; no browser launched. JUnit1failed/0skip and strict measured Runtime cleanup/sampler shutdown passed, with four separately outer-reaped descendants. Independent actual failure review `8bf57b7d` binds those partial results and preserved raw identities. The five-tool-Run/browser gate remains failed; a separate resource read created an additional Run, not a fourth tool Run. Both failed attempts are retained without relabeling or retry. Separately qualified V4 at current3ec failed the external launch-evidence assertion after Playwright returned zero: JUnit1failed/0skip44.338s. Independent5fe7bbe6 verifies five declared tool Runs plus two separate resource Runs, sampled public Core members, strict internal Runtime cleanup/final sampler and six separate outer reaps. Original JSON/DEBUG was overwritten by an empty exception fallback; no authoritative retained copy exists. Command zero and persisted Runs do not admit the browser gate. Scoped21385511 preserves this failure; NamedV5 passed fresh independent qualification3e57 and one separately authorized actual attempt at unchanged3ec/native92498. Independent actual1848613d accepts its narrow one-browser-case/five-tool-Run gate, with original named-case JSON stderr launch path, JUnit1PASS0skip46.049s, three exact owned commands0 and strict internal Runtime/sampler cleanup; outer6 reaps are separate. Corrected scoped28b2 retains18raw/50reference/1192/273 postchecks. PublicCore remains a three-member/RECORD sample, not wholewheel/coldregistry; no naturalexit/livePID/universalcleanup or productionChatGPT/artifact gate is inferred. Current hosted Windows source tests separately fail five synthetic checkout-byte fixture cells before probe assertions; LF→CRLF reproduces the measured digest, with the production probe unchanged. Current Mac integration also fails at an empty PID-file handoff before timeout/cleanup assertions. Those source corrections and fresh fullCI remain prerequisites for merge. Full Canvas/ChatGPT/artifact/private acceptance remains open.

Historical source evidence follows with original identities and checkpoint statuses.

Current candidate `14c1c1965314b192c4118c3281f5539d29f0aa6f`, tree `b95b352dd20cec016ea5dac204b81eeb331a8b3d`, normally preserves original `ca3ea2aa` and accepted `fbde0d3a` through merge `71aab046`. The existing cache fixture and mounted resource/five persisted Run assertions remain intact.

A separate explicit public-Core mode now performs zero candidate wheel builds or post-install overrides. It measures Core1.0.3 version, distribution ownership/prefix and three worker-module hashes against independently verified published wheel digest; this is sampled-member provenance, not whole installed-wheel authentication or cold registry acquisition. Default candidate mode remains separately labelled. Public mode requires an owned outer-run hook and explicit measured browser path/hash/lock identity passed through actual JS executablePath; the hook preserves subprocess arguments and CompletedProcess behavior. Existing120-second native readiness and assertions are unchanged. Production/frontend/workflow/manifest bytes are unchanged;268 producer inputs and five native test bodies remain equal92498.

Meaningful RED11→GREEN18 controls and24 scoped tests passed (four integration deselected,zero skips),Doctor/Bootstrap,Toolkit69,full configured lint/Isort/type335 passed. Independent source review SHA256 `b1737888384c60a1c6694e0c2567eac85515cf775ba49425f5c039ff6efaa676` authorizes normal push of source only. Fresh full CI and an independently reviewed immutable owned runner precede one frozen-only actual attempt; source approval is not native execution approval. No current actual execution or Runtime rebuild is claimed. The self-launching helper's child bytes must be pinned along with imported helper/observer bytes.

Canonical operations guidance records public/candidate provenance, cache containment, explicit browser selection and owned-hook boundaries. Whole99, authorized output, production template/ChatGPT and broad cleanup/release gates remain open. Upstream disposition: none.

Historical cache repair and actual evidence follow with their original identities:

The opt-in Canvas Runtime acceptance fixture synchronized uv's cache inside its action source package. Directory symlinks created by uv were correctly rejected by Runtime's source snapshot, so the fixture could not reach browser verification. This moves its cache and temporary build state into a unique sibling directory; production source-containment rules are unchanged.

Refreshed head: `ca3ea2aa4c8a5fa7c1d9773f79347dfb64f310cc`; tree: `ab17a0cf3970273c86d3c4f1d26d3da852c9585f`. The ordinary merge adds accepted PR304 (`19380993febaa71238eaee3026b5c808773283ff`) and its deterministic registry-floor verifier. Independent union review confirms the original fixture bytes are unchanged and accepted floor content is preserved. Review receipt SHA-256 `6982169bccf4e6a754615e932b4c05188f251adfa6214cce5d144afe8feab727`. Independent source and actual-evidence reviews recommend GO for this bounded #99 test repair.

Validation (browser/frontend results below are bound to original head `f9c424f7c625297514dbfeaa35ecc0e4b5797e22`, tree `3d9210abefb1e9d2f5b031e2a20870d7950ae303`; the refreshed head requires new hosted CI):
- The focused Runtime/browser test passed: 1 passed, 2 deselected.
- The RCC FrontendTest task passed all 280 tests.
- Runtime served the exact MCP Apps resource and persisted five successful Runs from three Python MCP calls and two browser calls.
- The worker used a source-candidate Core 1.0.3 wheel, SHA-256 `80f8e0b828ceb92d7cb7412a92f9306a4b0d2960365bf9aee899ad0cd71144f8`.
- A separate exact-head replay passed (1 passed, 2 deselected) with direct `DEBUG=pw:browser` launch tracing. Playwright 1.62.1 launched Chromium headless-shell revision 1234, SHA-256 `e11fc9ce65c96313476f7ee9844b6fb6a9220fb048693cfe9eee00acf4170a9f`; the main browser process exited 0. Independent review verified the trace, executable, resource, candidate wheel, and five persisted Runs. The original `0b20b130...` hash identifies the companion full-Chrome binary; its earlier inferred selection was corrected without deleting prior evidence.
- Exact-head hosted checks remain pending. The initial failed attempts are retained; the first summary receipt's bytes were not recoverable, and that limitation is recorded with its known hash.

Actual ChatGPT, production authorization/CSP, artifact resolution, and published Runtime integration remain NOT RUN or NOT PROVEN. Teardown left no known live children, but PID 1 retained zombie descendants; complete process reaping is not claimed. Whole #99 acceptance remains open.

Canonical guidance will retain the verified cache-containment and managed-browser selection lessons with the evidence checkpoint. Upstream disposition: none; this is an Actions-owned fixture defect.
